footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. The operating loss widened to $125M from $83.1M.
The net loss widened to $111M, or −$2.86 per share, from $78.3M. Operating cash flow was −$87.5M and free cash flow −$88.1M, versus −$67.2M.
sources: Rapport Therapeutics, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

risks: We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company with a limited operating history, which may make it difficult to evaluate our current business…
Our business is highly dependent on the success of our product candidates, particularly RAP-219 for focal onset seizures
The successful development of pharmaceutical products involves a lengthy and expensive process and is highly uncertain
Due to the significant resources required for the development of our pipeline, and depending on our ability to access capital…
The regulatory approval processes of the Food and Drug Administration, European Medicines Agency, Medicines…
We are dependent on a third party having accurately generated, collected, interpreted and reported data from certain preclinical studies…
strategy: Advance RAP-219 Phase 3 clinical development in FOS
Expand the potential of RAP-219 in additional neurological and psychiatric indications
Extend the life cycle of RAP-219 and expand the TARP 8 franchise
Advance development of our RAP-enabled nAChR programs
Fortify our leadership position in RAP-enabled drug discovery to expand our pipeline of transformative precision neuroscience therapies for patients
